title: Intention for Umrah
preview: “O Allah, I intend to perform Umrah — make it easy for me and accept it from me”

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ الْعُمْرَةَ فَيَسِّرْهَا لِي وَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي
items.tr: Allahumma inni uridul-'umrata fa-yassirha li wa taqabbalha minni
items.ru: “O Allah, I intend to perform Umrah — make it easy for me and accept it from me”
items.src: A formula from Hanafi fiqh books (al-Hidayah and others)

title: Talbiyah
preview: “Here I am before You, O Allah, here I am! Here I am, You have no partner, here I am! Truly, praise, grace and dominion are Yours. You have no partner”.

items.ar: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
items.tr: Labbayk Allahumma labbayk. Labbayka la sharika laka labbayk. Innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk. La sharika lak.
items.ru: “Here I am before You, O Allah, here I am! Here I am, You have no partner, here I am! Truly, praise, grace and dominion are Yours. You have no partner”.

html:
لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
Labbayk Allahumma labbayk. Labbayka la sharika laka labbayk. Innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk. La sharika lak.
“Here I am before You, O Allah, here I am! Here I am, You have no partner, here I am! Truly, praise, grace and dominion are Yours. You have no partner”.
al-Bukhari 1549, Muslim 1184

title: Entering the mosque
preview: “In the name of Allah, peace and blessings be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy”.

items.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
items.tr: Bismillah, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala rasulillah. Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik.

title: Approaching Safa (once)
preview: “As-Safa and al-Marwah are among the rite-signs of Allah”. “I begin with what Allah began with”.

items.ar: إِنَّ ٱلصَّفَا وَٱلْمَرْوَةَ مِن شَعَآئِرِ ٱللَّهِ · أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ
items.tr: Innas-safa wal-marwata min sha'a'irillah. Abda'u bima bada'allahu bih.
items.ru: “As-Safa and al-Marwah are among the rite-signs of Allah”. “I begin with what Allah began with”.

Innas-safa wal-marwata min sha'a'irillah. Abda'u bima bada'allahu bih.

title: On Safa and on Marwah · facing the Kaaba, hands raised
preview: Allahu akbar ×3. La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. La ilaha illallahu wahdah, anjaza wa'dah, wa nasara 'abdah, wa hazamal-ahzaba wahdah.

items.ar: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ×٣ · لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
items.tr: Allahu akbar ×3. La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. La ilaha illallahu wahdah, anjaza wa'dah, wa nasara 'abdah, wa hazamal-ahzaba wahdah.

html:
اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ×٣ · لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
Allahu akbar ×3. La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. La ilaha illallahu wahdah, anjaza wa'dah, wa nasara 'abdah, wa hazamal-ahzaba wahdah.
Muslim 1218. Then your own du'a.

title: Salam to the people of the graves · Uhud, Baqi
preview: “Peace be upon you, believers and Muslims, people of these dwellings! We, if Allah wills, will join you. We ask Allah for well-being for us and for you”

items.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَلَاحِقُونَ، نَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ

items.ru: “Peace be upon you, believers and Muslims, people of these dwellings! We, if Allah wills, will join you. We ask Allah for well-being for us and for you”

title: Getting into transport
preview: “Glory be to the One Who has made this subject to us, for we ourselves were not able to do it. Truly, we will return to our Lord (43:13–14). O Allah, on this journey we ask You for righteousness, God-consciousness and deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance”.

items.ar: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ×٣ · سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَٰذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَىٰ، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَٰذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ
items.tr: Allahu akbar ×3. Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila Rabbina la-munqalibun. Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda. Allahumma hawwin 'alayna safarana hadha watwi 'anna bu'dah.
items.ru: “Glory be to the One Who has made this subject to us, for we ourselves were not able to do it. Truly, we will return to our Lord (43:13–14). O Allah, on this journey we ask You for righteousness, God-consciousness and deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance”.

html:
اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ×٣ · سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَٰذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَىٰ، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَٰذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ
Allahu akbar ×3. Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila Rabbina la-munqalibun. Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda. Allahumma hawwin 'alayna safarana hadha watwi 'anna bu'dah.
“Glory be to the One Who has made this subject to us, for we ourselves were not able to do it. Truly, we will return to our Lord (43:13–14). O Allah, on this journey we ask You for righteousness, God-consciousness and deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance”.
Muslim 1342; Quran 43:13–14 (translation of the meaning)
